descriptions./: Explore Odisha’s people, places, culture and opportunities. Find the knowledge to plan your visit or investment.
descriptions./404.html: Find your way back to Project Odisha’s stories, coastal guides and saved journey ideas.
descriptions./explore/: Find places, coastal food and stay-area guides in the first Project Odisha collection. Search by name, topic or place connection.
descriptions./journey/: Collect Odisha places and meals, arrange your days, add personal notes and download an offline tour book. Your plans stay in your browser.
descriptions./journey-starters/: Choose a city, coast or Chilika starting collection. Save ideas into a separate journey, arrange your own days and carry an offline tour book.
descriptions./about/: Why Project Odisha is building a shared encyclopedia of Odisha’s places, people and living heritage, one carefully told story at a time.
descriptions./founder/: Meet Ahimanikya Satapathy, Founder & Editor-in-Chief of Project Odisha, and the personal purpose behind this growing collection.
descriptions./contribute/: Help improve Project Odisha with a correction, a source or firsthand knowledge. Prepare a draft locally and choose whether to share it publicly.
descriptions./how-to-use/: Discover a story, save an idea, arrange your journey and carry your notes offline. A practical introduction to using Project Odisha.
descriptions./destinations/bhubaneswar/: Begin in Bhubaneswar: follow stories in stone, choose a few places to linger and connect the city with Dhauli and the Odisha coast.
descriptions./visit/places/dhauli/: Look closely at Dhauli’s layered landscape of remembrance and belief. Plan a thoughtful visit and continue towards Konark.
descriptions./knowledge/konark/: Explore Konark through its Sun Temple, carved details, coastal connections and food. Gather ideas for your own Odisha journey.
descriptions./destinations/puri/: Discover Puri through the shore, its living sacred traditions and food. Leave space for local rhythms and a visit to Raghurajpur.
descriptions./visit/places/raghurajpur/: Meet Raghurajpur through its craft tradition and village setting. Approach a visit with curiosity, respect and time to look closely.
descriptions./food/puri-coast/: A coastal table: explore Mahaprasad, fish, prawns and chhena poda with context and questions to ask before choosing your meal.
descriptions./visit/stays/puri-coast/: Compare Puri and Konark as bases for a coastal visit. Consider the setting, transport and facilities, then check a property directly.
descriptions./visit/places/mukteswar/: Pause at Mukteswar’s carved gateway in Bhubaneswar. Explore the temple through photographs, architectural details and practical questions for your visit.
descriptions./food/bhubaneswar/: Make room for dalma, pakhala and chhena poda in Bhubaneswar. Discover the dishes, ask about their preparation and save a meal idea for your journey.
descriptions./visit/stays/bhubaneswar/: Compare Old Town, central Bhubaneswar and arrival-focused accommodation areas. Ask about transport, facilities and the exact address before booking.
descriptions./food/enduri-pitha/: Open the leaf around Enduri pitha: discover its Prathamastami association, documented preparations and questions to take to an Odisha kitchen.
descriptions./food/poda-pitha/: Discover Poda pitha through Raja, named preparations and the people behind them. Save a food story and questions for your Odisha journey.
descriptions./languages/atlas/: Explore Odisha’s mother-tongue population across 30 districts, compare rural and urban counts, and follow language stories using Census 2011 data.
descriptions./languages/districts/: Start with a place: explore the recorded mother tongues of all 30 Odisha districts in Census 2011, then follow their language stories.
descriptions./languages/multilingual-odisha/: Read Odisha’s Census 2011 language counts: overlapping multilingual totals, grouped mother-tongue returns and the limits of what the tables can tell us.
descriptions./languages/sambalpuri/: Follow Sambalpuri through Rangabati’s makers, writing and living culture, then explore its Census 2011 district distribution.
descriptions./languages/desia/: Meet Desia through documented learning and theatre, careful naming and Census 2011 population connections.

descriptions./food/everyday/: Start with a small bowl. Follow a fruit, a handful of badi, a leaf-wrapped parcel—and the people who make them memorable.
descriptions./food/ou-khatta/: A little sweet, a little sour. The bowl at the edge of the meal has a story of its own.
descriptions./food/badi-chura/: A handful of crumbs, a generous amount of character. Meet the little accompaniment that deserves a closer look.
descriptions./food/tala-pitha/: A golden slice and a browned edge. Follow ripe palm fruit into one of Odisha’s seasonal food stories.
descriptions./food/fire-cooking/: A blistered vegetable, an opened leaf parcel, a browned edge. Follow the heat into three food stories—and leave room for the cook’s own version.
descriptions./food/baigana-poda/: A blistered skin gives way to a soft centre. Follow roasted eggplant from the flame to a small bowl beside the meal.
descriptions./food/tomato-poda/: A tomato meets the heat; a meal gains another small bowl. Discover the roasted accompaniment through one cook’s account.
descriptions./food/patrapoda/: Open a leaf parcel and the story changes with what is inside. Meet mushroom, fish and prawn preparations without treating them as one dish.
descriptions./crafts/: A cut piece of cloth. A brush held close. A silver thread bent into a pattern. Follow three crafts into the decisions—and the people—behind them.
descriptions./crafts/pipili-applique/: Colour catches your eye. A seam holds it there. Look closely at the cut cloth, the stitched edge and the person who brings the pattern together.
descriptions./crafts/pattachitra/: Before you try to understand the whole painting, follow one line. A border, a gesture, a tiny face can open a much larger story.
descriptions./textiles/: A pattern planned in yarn. A poem woven into silk. A colour drawn from roots. Follow Odisha’s textile stories into the materials, places and people behind the cloth.
descriptions./textiles/sambalpuri-bandha/: A peacock opens its tail across the cloth. Follow the pattern backwards, and you arrive at a bundle of yarn—and the decisions made before weaving began.
descriptions./textiles/khandua/: A page can be made of thread. In this Khandua, lettering moves across red cloth—an invitation to meet poetry, devotion and the people who weave them together.
descriptions./knowledge/kotpad/: Before a colour reaches the loom, there is another story to tell. In Kotpad, following the red leads towards roots, dyeing knowledge and the people who keep it alive.
descriptions./textiles/tasar/: Before the border and the drape, there is a cocoon. Follow Tasar from branch to yarn, then towards the places and people who give the silk its next life.
descriptions./knowledge/chilika/: Explore Chilika Lake through its birds, boats, island stories and local food. Compare shores and collect ideas for your own Odisha journey.
descriptions./global-connections/: Explore Bhubaneswar’s international links, compare Indian city partnerships, and imagine cultural and learning collaborations for Odisha.
